decided_by.exact_evaluation_rule: DAY-18J (recovered; not a new protocol-owner decision in this task)

changed_sections: v2.0.3 item 1: evaluation semantics of the precision-interval rule (exact rational arithmetic authoritative; float64 diagnostic only)
new diagnostic classifications NUMERICAL_FALSE_POSITIVE (NON-BLOCKING, recorded) and NUMERICAL_FALSE_NEGATIVE (exact detection authoritative)
review-record interaction: v2.0.3 record whose item is no longer detected under exact evaluation -> MOOT
unchanged_sections: v2.0.3 precision rule mathematics: d_k, delta_k, rho, rho_min, rho_max, detection condition

existing DAY-18F review records (historically valid, unmodified)

rationale.defect: v2.0.3 defines the precision-interval rule mathematically but leaves numerical evaluation semantics unspecified; finite-precision float64 evaluation can create or hide detections at the closed endpoint.
rationale.history: DAY-18H found that the two remaining v2.0.3 UNEXPLAINED_CHANGE items (AMZN 2016-02-22, NFLX 2018-11-29) have exact rho_max = 1 while float64 evaluates rho_max as 1 - 2.22e-16 (1 ULP) and 1 - 1.11e-16 (0.5 ULP), creating detections. These items are history only; the rule below is general and does not resolve them.
rationale.no_tolerance: an epsilon or tolerance would change the mathematical rule; exact evaluation reproduces the v2.0.3 rule as written.
rationale.symmetry: exact evaluation removes float artifacts in both directions (false detections and hidden detections).

exact_evaluation_rule.mathematical_rule: unchanged from v2.0.3: detected iff NOT (rho_min <= 1 <= rho_max)
exact_evaluation_rule.value_source: IEEE 754 binary64 values persisted in column close of bars_raw/<SYMBOL>.parquet (raw close r) and bars_all/<SYMBOL>.parquet (adjusted close a) of the immutable snapshot under evaluation
exact_evaluation_rule.raw_close_conversion: exact rational denoted by the shortest round-trip decimal representation of the persisted binary64 value
exact_evaluation_rule.adjusted_close_conversion: each stored adjusted close is converted from its shortest round-trip decimal representation into an exact rational number (same representation rule as raw closes)
exact_evaluation_rule.shortest_round_trip_definition: decimal string with the fewest significant digits that converts back to the identical binary64 under round-to-nearest-even; if several, the one numerically closest to the binary64 value
exact_evaluation_rule.raw_close_delta: none (raw closes exact, unchanged from v2.0.2/v2.0.3)
exact_evaluation_rule.f_t: f = R / A, exact rational quotient of the exact raw and adjusted values
exact_evaluation_rule.d_k: unchanged: number of displayed decimal places used by v2.0.3
exact_evaluation_rule.arithmetic: all v2.0.3 formulas evaluated using exact rational arithmetic
exact_evaluation_rule.float64: may be calculated only as diagnostic information

invalid_value_rule.precision_degenerate: existing v2.0.3 degenerate check remains authoritative: a - delta <= 0 -> item remains BLOCKING per existing protocol
invalid_value_rule.exact_evaluation_invalid: a non-finite, non-positive, or non-convertible value that cannot be represented under exact evaluation -> EXACT_EVALUATION_INVALID

NUMERICAL_FALSE_POSITIVE.recording: must be recorded in the evaluation evidence

review_record_interaction.item_no_longer_detected_under_exact_v2_0: record status MOOT (not INVALID); remains in history

precision-based exemption for undetected genuine events
remaining v2.0.3 UNEXPLAINED_CHANGE items (AMZN 2016-02-22, NFLX 2018-11-29)
